evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: ﬁled in: Malware , Threat Prevention , Unit 42 tagged: command and control , DNS , pisloader , Wekby We have observed an attack led by the APT group Wekby targeting a US-based organization in recent weeks.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: Wekby is a group that has been active for a number of years, targeting various industries such as healthcare, telecommunications, aerospace, defense, and high tech.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: The group is known to leverage recently released exploits very shortly after those exploits are available, such as in the case of HackingTeamâ€™s Flash zero-day exploit .

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: The malware used by the Wekby group has ties to the HTTPBrowser malware family, and uses DNS requests as a command and control mechanism.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: Additionally, it uses various obfuscation techniques to thwart researchers during analysis.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: This discovered ﬁle was found to be an instance of the common Poison Ivy malware family with the following conﬁguration data:

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: After this ﬁle is written, the malware executes the newly written lsm.exe ﬁle, which contains the pisloader payload.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: FrameworkPOS C3PRO-RACCOON FeederBot Morto PlugX Variants The use of DNS as a C2 allows pisloader to bypass certain security products that may not be inspecting this trafﬁc correctly.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: The pisloader sample will send a beacon periodically that is composed of a random 4-byte uppercase string that is used as the payload.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: A single host of â€˜ns1.logitech-usa[.]comâ€™ is found in this speciﬁc sample.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: Additionally, a number of commands themselves, such as the â€˜listâ€™, â€˜driveâ€™, and â €˜uploadâ€™ commands are consistent with HTTPBrowser.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: A known HTTPBrowser sample was spotted with similar metadata as the discussed pisloader sample, which adds further credibility that pisloader is likely a variant of this malware family.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: Conclusion The Wekby group continues to target various high proﬁle organizations using sophisticated malware.

evidences.report_id: PaloAlto_New- Wekby-Attacks-Use- DNS-Requests- As- Command-and- Control- Mechanism(5-24-16)
evidences.text: The pisloader malware family uses various novel techniques, such as using DNS as a C2 protocol, as well as making use of return-oriented programming and other anti-analysis tactics.
